engine: wheel-hijack fullpage pager (custom controller; NO Lenis / NO GSAP / NO ScrollTrigger). Harvested 1:1 from live EVER (ever-live-here.com) landing.js.

curtainMs.what: paired pane travel: incoming translateY +100%->0 while outgoing 0->-100%. The visible curtain duration (EVER config says 1200 but the eased travel completes ~850).

contentMs.what: the CONTENT settle clock (wordmark clipped-rise + per-line rise + bg zoom). MUST be longer than curtainMs — the overhang is the luxury feel.

bgZoomMs.what: incoming background image scale duration; outlasts the curtain for depth.

ease.what: Penner easing, verbatim from EVER. easeOutQuart = 1-(1-t)^4 = the front-loaded fast-lift-slow-settle curtain feel. Measured live: ~59% of travel in the first 200ms.

lockPad.what: added to curtainMs for the input lock so one wheel gesture can't double-fire mid-curtain.

copyDelay.what: delay before [data-fade] sub-copy fades+rises (a beat after the risers start).

loop.what: wrap from last section back to first.

measured_curtain_curve_588px.note: incoming Y over a 588px (one viewport) path, sampled live off EVER. Front-loaded easeOutQuart.

reveal.model: TRANSLATE-only (EVER barely fades). [data-rise] / .rise = clipped-rise from below an overflow:hidden wrap. [data-rise-line] is auto-split into per-line rising spans. [data-fade] = the sparing opacity+rise for sub copy only.
reveal.settle: all risers settle over contentMs (outlasts the curtain), tiny per-item cascade (k*0.05).

law: transform + opacity only; every .pane its own GPU layer (translateZ(0)/will-change/backface-hidden/contain:layout paint); NO mix-blend / NO backdrop-filter over a moving pane; NO clip-path on the moving pane (curtain is pure translateY). prefers-reduced-motion / coarse-small -> static stacked scroll (no hijack).
entry: SectionPager.init(target, options) -> { go, to, current, ease, destroy }  (markup-first: pages the .pane children of target).
